findings.evidence: `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/JordanChevalley/Multiplicative.lean:65` `def IsSemisimple (g : GeneralLinearGroup K V)` inside `namespace TauCeti` / `namespace GeneralLinearGroup` (line 54); same for `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/GeneralLinearGroup/TensorProduct.lean:38` `def tensorProduct (g : GeneralLinearGroup K V)`. findings.fix: Put these declarations in a namespace naming the type they are about — `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup` (the repo already extends root `Matrix`, e.g. `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Triangular.lean:38`) or `TauCeti.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup` — and leave `TauCeti.GeneralLinearGroup` to the module-GL material.
findings.issue: `namespace GeneralLinearGroup` (i.e. `TauCeti.GeneralLinearGroup`) is already the repo's namespace for `LinearMap.GeneralLinearGroup K V`, the abstract GL of a module; the new `entryEval`, `detPoly`, `polynomialFunctions`, `rationalFunctions` and their lemmas are about the unrelated type `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) k`. One namespace now names two different objects, so `open TauCeti.GeneralLinearGroup` mixes `IsSemisimple (g : GeneralLinearGroup K V)` with `det_mem_polynomialFunctions` about `GL (Fin n) k`. It also makes `polynomialFunctions` ambiguous with Mathlib's root-level `polynomialFunctions` (Mathlib/Topology/ContinuousMap/Polynomial.lean).

findings.evidence: Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/ZPow.lean:108 `theorem _root_.IsUnit.det_zpow`, :113 `isUnit_det_zpow_iff`; `ZPow` camelCase occurs only in UpperCamelCase/instance names (`instZPow`, `evalZPow`). Naming conventions, "Identifiers and theorem names".

findings.issue: `toMatrix_mem_of_toMatrix_mem` (and `toMatrix_mem_of_toMatrix_mem_of_surjective`, line 317) sit in the bare `TauCeti` namespace with an ambiguous `toMatrix`: the statement is about `LinearMap.toMatrix`, but the lemma's whole content is a change of basis, where `Basis.toMatrix` is the other reading. The convention requires prepending the namespace in lowerCamelCase when the bare definition name is ambiguous.

findings.evidence: Line 253: `(hf : ∀ i, f i ∈ rationalFunctions k n)`; lines 203, 209, 216 use the fully qualified `_mem_polynomialFunctions` / `_mem_rationalFunctions` suffixes.
findings.issue: `exists_forall_eq_inv_mul_of_forall_mem` names the hypothesis as `mem` without saying membership in what; in this namespace there are two subalgebras and the hypothesis is `∀ i, f i ∈ rationalFunctions k n`. Every sibling spells the subalgebra out (`entry_mem_polynomialFunctions`, `det_mem_polynomialFunctions`, `detZPow_mem_rationalFunctions`).

summary: The two headline predicates match the pinned `IsRationalRep` signature and no notation is introduced, but the new declarations land in `TauCeti.GeneralLinearGroup`, a namespace the repo already uses exclusively for `LinearMap.GeneralLinearGroup K V`, and several lemma names use non-standard or under-determined tokens (`detZPow`, bare `toMatrix`, bare `of_forall_mem`).
